title: centaurea resupinata subsp. lagascae
intro: Centaurea resupinata subsp. lagascae, commonly known as Knapweed or Lagascalian Knapweed, is a plant species in the daisy family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, thereby providing various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea resupinata subsp. lagascae include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
